Class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessorTest

@IsTest
private class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessorTest

Test class for PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor. Verifies successful creation and linking of PaymentAuthorization__c records from Stripe webhook payloads, error handling for failed upserts, and error logging for failed StripeTransaction__c updates.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void paymentAuthorizationLinkFailureTest()

Verifies error logging when StripeTransaction__c update fails during payment authorization linking. Directly invokes saveStripeTransactions() with an invalid payment authorization ID (using User ID) to trigger update failure and verify error is logged to ErrorLog__c.

@IsTest
private static void paymentAuthorizationParseFailureTest()

Verifies error logging when message parsing fails. Tests that when parsing produces an exception, it is properly logged to ErrorLog__c and no PaymentAuthorization__c record is created.

@IsTest
private static void paymentAuthorizationTest()

Verifies successful creation and linking of a PaymentAuthorization__c record from Stripe webhook payload. Tests that PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor correctly processes a charge.succeeded event with card_present payment method details, creates a PaymentAuthorization__c record, and links it to the StripeTransaction__c.

@IsTest
private static void paymentAuthorizationUpsertFailureTest()

Verifies error logging when PaymentAuthorization__c upsert fails due to validation errors. Tests that when field mapping produces an invalid record, the error is properly logged to ErrorLog__c and no PaymentAuthorization__c record is created.
